meta.description: Curated civilian resilience-logistics scenario dataset for SeaWatch Phase 9 (RESPOND). Capacity, cost, risk, and demand figures are scenario/synthetic planning values for human review, NOT real operational data. Port names and coordinates are public civilian facts; great-circle distances are derived from those public coordinates.

scenarios.description_zh: 高雄港在此情境中暫時無法使用（原因不明、未歸因）。南部的醫療、食品與燃料民生需求必須改由其他民用港口承接。此為供人工審查的規劃情境，並非真實事件或預測。
scenarios.description_en: In this scenario Kaohsiung Port is temporarily unavailable (cause unspecified and non-attributed). Southern civilian medical, food, and fuel demand must be absorbed by alternative civilian ports. This is a planning scenario for human review, not a real event or a prediction.
